description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing titles and detecting duplicate titles within a notes application. It includes functions to normalize a title string by trimming and collapsing whitespace, as well as checking for duplicate titles in a list of notes, excluding trashed notes and optionally excluding a specific note by ID.

methods.name: normalizeTitle(raw)
methods.description: Normalizes a string title by trimming whitespace, collapsing internal whitespace, and converting to lowercase unless case-sensitive matching is enabled via environment variable.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTitle({ title, notes, excludeId = null })
methods.description: Checks whether a note with a normalized title already exists in the provided notes list, excluding trashed notes and optionally excluding a note by ID. It respects environment variable to allow or disallow duplicate titles.

ctags.name: hasDuplicateTitle
ctags.pattern: /^export function hasDuplicateTitle({ title, notes, excludeId = null }) {$/
